title: The Magic Hat
summary: 学魔法+苦练成功:主角发现旧魔法帽和魔杖,跟奶奶学念咒语苦练,终于自己变出一只鸟。
text: {{name}} finds an old box at home. In the box, there is a black hat. There is a little wand too. "What is this?" {{name}} asks. Grandma looks at the hat. "It is a magic hat," she says. "Can I try?" asks {{name}}. Grandma sings a funny song. Then a white rabbit jumps out! "Wow! Can I do it too?" "Yes, but you must learn," says Grandma. Every day, {{name}} learns the funny song. {{name}} works hard with the wand. One day, the hat moves! A little bird flies out of the hat. "I did it! I did magic!" Grandma is very happy. "Now you are my little helper," she says.

questions.prompt: What is in the old box?
What flies out of the hat at the end?
